ctx.x: Mr. Blakeney, your first recording experiences out West was with the Sonny Clay Plantation Orchestra; this we do know. In that orchestra were people like W.B. Woodland, Ernest Coycault, Leonard "Big Boy" Davidson, Louis Dobbs; some gentleman whose last name was Fitzgerald--do you recall his first name? He was a banjo player.
